verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents access to 150+ customizable legal documents and prepares formation paperwork such as operating agreements, with a guarantee to correct filings that are wrong due to its error. It also bundles unlimited 30-minute attorney consults, a separate route to legal review. The evidence never describes a guided questionnaire flow or any in-document flagging of choices that need attorney review. missing for 10: explicit evidence of guided questionnaires driving document fill-in, automated flagging of risky choices for attorney review, independent hands-on corroboration of document accuracy.
